scenes.visualConcept: Scattered spending labels orbit a month-end calendar, making the lack of a coherent view perceptible.
Coffee, lunch, and travel purchases appear as small fragments that converge to show the source of the financial fog.
The product groups spending and income into meaningful categories, showing a state change from scattered entries to an ordered view.
A calm summary makes the whole financial picture legible and gives the viewer room to understand the changed state.
The final message lands as a clear invitation after the earlier fragments have become an understandable picture.
